lessons: Soft-404 detection: core.telegram.org/bots/business returned HTTP 200 with a 'Page not found' body. A curl status check cannot catch this; core.telegram.org URLs must be checked by page TITLE in a browser.

core.telegram.org is fully JS-rendered. WebFetch returns an empty shell and falsely reports 'page not found'. Always use Playwright for this host, including inside subagent prompts, or the Judge will mass-report SOURCE_UNREACHABLE.

Method-existence grep is now mandatory: getBusinessAccountChats and @grammyjs/session were both confidently-worded fabrications that survived prior cycles. Next cycle, grep every Bot API method name and every npm package name mentioned anywhere in the skill against the rendered method list / npm registry and require a hit for each.

Parameter-placement drift is a distinct failure mode from field-name drift: subscription_period exists in the API, just not on the method the skill used. Verifying 'the parameter is real' is not enough; verify it is real ON THAT METHOD.

Verify framework call signatures from the shipped .d.ts, not from memory. createInvoiceLink's positional argument order was confirmed against grammy@1.45.1 out/core/api.d.ts before writing the example.

SKILL.md is permanently at the 5,000-word ceiling. This cycle moved quickstarts, middleware, mini-apps, Telegraf/ptb webhook setups, and worked examples into references/. Any future addition must move an equal amount out. Keep RULES in the body and CODE in references, that split held up well here.

The EN/HE Examples parity gap flagged last cycle is RESOLVED: EN now has a '## Examples' pointer section and HE's 660-word inline examples were replaced with the same pointer, since references/examples.md already contained that content. Heading structure is now identical at 49 each.

Enriched DB content drifts independently of the body: the live FAQ still claimed grammY supported 'Bot API v9.5' while SKILL.md said v10.0. Always run the Phase 5.5 enriched-content fact-sync for this skill.

Two legacy evidence entries had raw_snippets copied from the skill's own markdown link text rather than the source page, passing self-consistency but failing --check-sources, and silently justifying several placeholder URLs. Watch for this pattern in other legacy skills.

DEFERRED to next cycle (Expert MAJOR findings, not blocking): Telegraf 4.16.3 has had no release since Feb 2024 and is still framed as 'stable, battle-tested' rather than dormant; the rate-limit remedy points at @grammyjs/transformer-throttler (last published 2022-11) instead of @grammyjs/auto-retry; references/conversations.md predates the @grammyjs/conversations 2.x replay model; no setMyCommands / language_code scoping despite this being a bilingual-bot skill; no file-handling section and no file_id bot-scoping gotcha; no deep-linking coverage; no webhook idempotency/redelivery guidance; Bot API 10.1/10.2 surfaces (Ephemeral Messages, Rich Messages) absent despite the skill claiming 10.2; the 10.2 Mini App cross-origin lockdown enforced 2026-07-20 is unmentioned; paid broadcasts not covered.

DEFERRED (MINOR): Hebrew string literals in quickstart code are written as "!שלום! אני הבוט שלך", a source-order artifact that renders a stray leading exclamation mark. Worth a sweep across references/quickstarts.md and examples.md.

PROPAGATION IS THE DOMINANT FAILURE MODE OF THIS SKILL'S UPDATE CYCLES. Three separate rounds failed because a correction landed in one file and not its siblings: EN fixed but not HE (Gifts, Stars pricing), SKILL files fixed but not references/deployment.md (plan quotas), body fixed but not evidence.json/domain-checklist (/revokentoken). Next cycle: after EVERY factual change, grep the OLD value across SKILL.md + SKILL_HE.md + every references/*.md + evidence.json + metadata.json, and require zero hits. Grep the CONCEPT too, not just the exact string, the Gifts miss happened because the sweep used 'convert it back into Stars' while the surviving copy said 'convert it back to Stars'.

Beware overcorrection when removing an unsourced number. The per-chat 1 msg/sec limit IS published in bots/faq; relabelling it 'not a published figure' deleted a true fact and contradicted domain-checklist item 9. Before softening a figure, search for it, absence of an evidence entry is not evidence of absence at the source.

Sanity-check every date you write. 2026-02-29 does not exist (2026 is not a leap year) and shipped into three files before a reviewer caught it. Re-read the raw registry/API response rather than retyping a year from memory.

evidence.json appears_in must name the file that actually carries the claim. Two entries pointed at the SKILL files for figures that live only in references/, which passes the self-consistency gate but misdirects the next reviewer.
verified_via must describe how the snippet was ACTUALLY obtained. A snippet found only inside a published npm tarball's .d.ts is 'typescript-declaration', not 'browser'.
